parsed.name: QuTech SPI S4g通量电流源
parsed.name_en: QuTech SPI S4g Flux Current Source
parsed.description: 一款多通道通量电流源，用于实验中为通量偏置线提供和管理电流输出。该设备支持将各通道安全缓慢降到零电流，适合超导量子比特等需要稳定直流偏置的场景。
parsed.description_en: A multi-channel flux current source used in experiments to provide and manage current output for flux-bias lines. It supports safely ramping channels down to zero current, making it suitable for setups such as superconducting qubits that require stable DC biasing.

actions.description: 打印按通道名称排序的设备概览信息。
actions.description_en: Print an overview of the device sorted by channel names.

actions.description: 将所有模块的电流输出安全缓慢降至零，以进入全零状态。
actions.description_en: Safely ramp all module current outputs down to zero to bring the system into an all-zero state.
